feeds.title: In The Margins
feeds.description: Achieving equality in higher education. The stakes have never been higher. The issues never more complex. Who graduates, and why? Who is getting hired as faculty and what is their experience?In each episode, we will look at issues surrounding students, faculty, diversity and inclusion, and skyrocketing college costs. From critical conversation to news, numbers, and analysis — we've got you covered. You can count on Diverse's In The Margins to bring you the latest, most relevant thought leadership as it pertains to diversity, inclusion, and equity in higher education...

feeds.title: New Jersey Education Aid Blog
feeds.description: Get Updates on the NJ Education Aid. Aimed at exposing the inequalities of New Jersey's Education Aid Distribution, this blog presents in-depth and mindful articles on New Jersey's Education aid crisis and other topics such as the Pension Crisis, Education budget, and Policy.

feeds.title: Education Week » New Jersey
feeds.description: Get the latest education policy news and instruction trends from New Jersey, including articles, opinion essays, data, and videos. Education Week is one of America's most trusted resources for K-12 education news and information. It delivers National coverage, from and about teachers to principals to district leaders across the country.

feeds.title: NJ Family » Education
feeds.description: Explore trending Articles tagged Education from NJ Family in this segment. Our experts discuss and offer insights to parents and individuals concerning a variety of topics related to their children's education. NJ Family magazine and website is an authoritative source on everything parenting to NJ moms, providing exceptional information on several topics to its readers.

feeds.title: Jersey City Times » Education
feeds.description: Jersey City Times' digital column on education provides conclusive news, opinions, and analysis of various developments across the News Jersey Education Spectrum. The Jersey City Times is dedicated to high-quality, in-depth coverage of Jersey City's people, neighborhoods, politics, schools, businesses, culture, and cuisine.

feeds.title: Jersey City Ed
feeds.description: Jersey City Ed is devoted to providing information about educational opportunities for children in Jersey City. Our mission is to empower parents and students to make informed decisions about their educational choices. Check the latest posts from our newsfeed to stay current in the latest educational opportunities and trends in the city.

feeds.title: Plymouth Rock Teachers Lounge Blog
feeds.description: At the Plymouth Rock Teachers' Lounge, we're all about supporting teachers. In this blog, you will discover inspiring stories from the front lines of teaching, informative and entertaining blogs from fellow educators, some useful tips on discounts, grants, or events for teachers and many more resources to make an educator's life easier.

feeds.title: JerseyCAN Blog
feeds.description: JerseyCAN is a non-profit organization dedicated to making available to students access to high-quality schools and continuous support with appropriate resources and excellent teaching, while also advocating for better teaching conditions for students. Read all our official communications, information and special articles here.

feeds.title: NJ Teacher to Teacher Blog
feeds.description: Read our blog articles providing engaging, current, and relevant content pertaining to Professional educational development in New Jersey. The New Jersey Teacher 2 Teacher consultants provide professional development to districts across NJ and surrounding areas through workshops, coaching, and other disciplines.

feeds.title: Musings From The Middle School Blog
feeds.description: Since 2014, I've been sharing my classroom with you on this blog. Everything from tech tips, to lesson ideas, to engagement strategies, to book recommendations, to resources - anything to help busy middle school teachers be their best. I'm Jenna and I'm a middle school teacher in south Jersey. Throughout my career, I've taught elementary and middle grades. I've been a co-teacher in our in-class resource setting, a basic skills teacher, and even a virtual teacher.

feeds.title: Students of History Blog
feeds.description: A blog featuring news, updates, and descriptions of Students of History resources for US History, World History, and the American Government. The most engaging and thorough social studies resources available anywhere! My name is Luke Rosa. I created this site to make it easier to share some of the social studies resources with the teachers that I've had success with.

feeds.title: ClassTechTips Blog
feeds.description: Class Tech Tips is an EdTech Blog that helps teachers and schools discover new an innovative ways to use technology in their classrooms. Monica Burns is a Curriculum and EdTech Consultant, Apple Distinguished Educator and Founder of ClassTechTips.com. She started ClassTechTips.com to provide a resource for educators and administrators on implementing EdTech in the classroom.

feeds.title: New Jersey Council of Teachers of English
feeds.description: The official blog of the New Jersey Council of Teachers of English, the state affiliate of the National Council of Teachers of English. We welcome contributions from teachers, librarians, administrators, parents, and students who are interested in sharing their ideas with the NJCTE community. Find real-life classroom stories, tips for teachers, teaching techniques and more!

feeds.title: NJACTE Blog
feeds.description: The New Jersey Association of Colleges for Teacher Education (NJACTE) is an organization whose work is focused on the preparation and professional development of teachers and educational leaders in the State of New Jersey. Its purpose is to promote the learning of all PK-12 students through the high-quality, evidence-based preparation and continuing education of teachers and teacher leaders. Explore the blog for resources on education, teachers' training and education and more!

feeds.title: Arts Ed NJ Blog
feeds.description: Arts Ed NJ Blog shares monthly posts written by the Arts Ed NJ staff. Explore insights, ideas, upcoming events & opportunities, and other engaging learning materials from Arts Ed NJ. Arts Ed NJ (previously the New Jersey Arts Education Partnership) is an organization dedicated to expanding access to arts education for all citizens across New Jersey.

feeds.title: NJ School Law Blog
feeds.description: Led by Sanmathi (Sanu) Dev, Esq. and featuring contributions from attorneys in Capehart Scatchard's school law group, this blog is devoted to current developments in New Jersey education law affecting school districts, charter schools, students, and employees.

feeds.title: NJ Tech Weekly » EdTech
feeds.description: Find the latest Edtech news, Product launches, Upcoming releases, and loads of exclusive insider content at njtechweekly.com. NJ Tech Weekly is a weekly as well as online news publication focusing on the dynamic Tech Industry and its related news topics in New Jersey.

feeds.title: GMAT Archives - Prep For Success Tutors
feeds.description: The GMAT section of the Prep For Success blog is a treasure trove of knowledge for aspiring business school students. This blog, which can be accessed at https://www.prepforsuccesstutors.com/blog/, is filled with free tips and tricks specifically tailored for the GMAT exam. The blog provides insights into various aspects of the GMAT exam, from content-specific advice to overall preparation strategies.

feeds.title: Chalkbeat Newark
feeds.description: Follow up on what happening in Newark Schools with Chalkbeat Newark's news articles. These posts feature opinions, and thoughts on Policy, Health and tackle several issues affecting the Public School system. Chalkbeat is a nonprofit news organization committed to covering essential education reporting across America.

feeds.title: Eduscape
feeds.description: Eduscape is an innovative platform that designs learning experiences that are personalized, data-driven, adaptive, and supported by communities of practice. Here you will find news and information about our latest technological innovations and programs that better the learning experience.
